text: Support is seeing R2s drop Wi-Fi every few hours since firmware 2.8 (released Aug 4). Hooli and Acme Foods so far. Opened FW-77. Smells like the roaming threshold change in the 2.8 wpa_supplicant config.
Should we pull 2.8 from the auto-update channel?
Pausing rollout now. Can't roll back units already on 2.8 without a site visit, so the real answer is a 2.8.1 hotfix. I'll own it.
Repro'd in the lab with two APs on different channels: robot holds a weak AP until RSSI -82 then deauths. 2.7 roamed at -72. Workaround for sites: power-cycle the robot. Not great.
Is the 'connection lost' banner in Atlas expected to flicker like that? I see it on the Hooli fleet in staging data.
That's FW-77 showing up in the UI. Let's debounce the banner to 30s so it isn't a strobe light.
